question: Can bounded modular representatives lower exact explicit group-operation counts for the fixed marked action, with identical optimization available to direct multiplication?

claims.text: Translated direct and fused point actions equal the fixed mu action.
The translated fused route has a lower minimum D+A than identically optimized direct multiplication within the frozen finite design.
claims.if_supported: A source-specific exact group-count improvement; no runtime implication.
claims.if_not_supported: Preserve the loss or tie and all plans.

claims.text: Translation lowers the direct count relative to its zero-shift control.

arms.description: Best direct signed-window plan within the same representative scan.

flags.table_points: Accumulated across both fused scalar calls

arms.description: Complete width2 multiplication by ell followed by the translated correcting scalar; both tables charged.

flags.table_points: Accumulated across both fused scalar calls

arms.description: Centered direct scalar, optimized over the same six widths.

flags.table_points: Accumulated across both fused scalar calls

arms.description: Centered correcting scalar plus the complete small-scalar step.

aa.not_applicable_reason: Exact deterministic finite enumeration without a timing metric; reconstruct every scalar and qualify actual API counts.

positive.not_applicable_reason: Separate native qualification checks 1500 boundary scalar/point/window cases against OpenSSL and analytic counters; all 200 selected-plan point cases must also pass.

negative.not_applicable_reason: Every zero-shift row is an unchanged-method negative control; centered paths remain baseline arms. No stochastic null population is inferred.

factors.name: curves and scalars
factors.how: Same seven JSON inputs; hashes in execution.placement.input_files. P-192 primary.

factors.name: shift
factors.value: Every integer -256..256 from each centered scalar
factors.how: Complete census; no adaptive bound after observations.

factors.name: window
factors.how: Every width retained; small-scalar ell uses width2.

factors.name: addition weight
factors.how: Primary D+A; secondary D+tau*A, tau2..4. Tie key score,N,D,A,abs(j),j,width. Proxies, not runtime weights.

factors.name: instrument
factors.how: Published source and binary digests; identical evaluator implementation for every arm.

factors.name: point dependence
factors.value: Nonzero order-n point for schedules; identity as a correctness control
factors.how: Analytic API counts checked against actual point operations; no input logarithm supplied to evaluator.

factors.name: host and threads
factors.how: Development count diagnostic; no clock metric or latency inference.

variable_ledger.aa_not_applicable: Exact deterministic census without a timing metric.

randomization.arm_order_reason: No hardware-dependent metric; all methods use the full identical deterministic design.

seed_derivation.note: No random sampling; seed is a design identifier only.

instance_sampling.rule: Five curves, two centered scalars, six widths, 513 shifts: 30780 schedules.

blinding.how: Mechanical exact minimum and tie rule fixed before data.

power.note: Complete finite census, no stochastic or population inference. Strict integer inequality decides each curve separately. No significance or statistical-power claim.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: No timing pilot. Single scan and qualification each have a 120-second hard deadline; retain timeout.

primary.name: Explicit group doubles plus additions
primary.definition: D+A including odd tables and complete small-scalar ell step for fused. Minimum over frozen shifts and widths.

secondary.name: Named group counter vector
secondary.definition: Doubles, additions, negations and cumulative table points; D+tau*A, tau2..4, is sensitivity only.

stopping_rules.rule: Exactly 30780 schedules then all 200 selected-plan point checks. No changed scalar, extra shifts or alternative score after data.
Wrong digit/point/count, hash mismatch, missing or duplicate row, incomplete archive or timeout invalidates and is retained.

invalidation_rules: Any wrong scalar/point/count, incomplete census, missing hash or invalid archive prevents the affected count claim.
Original runtime objective requires a separately admitted cold timing comparison.

decision_rule.text: Per curve compare minimum translated fused and translated direct D+A. Strictly smaller: supported_within_scope; equal: tied; larger: candidate_higher_count. Preserve centered controls and all sensitivity weights. No runtime implication.
decision_rule.threshold: Strict integer inequality at addition weight1
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: Absolute count difference and ratio, with all components

graphs: Centered and translated direct/fused count minima per curve

inadmissible: Different mu or point per arm
Ignoring plan generation in future first-use accounting
Claiming global quotient evaluation from subgroup recoding

literature.claim: Signed expansions and digit-set optimality are established background. No novelty or runtime-optimality claim.
